thread:
alex: Heads-up — hitting a parity bug between REST and Node SDK during onboarding. REST `POST /v1/sessions` accepts `auth_token` and returns 200; SDK `client.createSession({ token: '...' })` returns 401.

alex: Quick repro below (curl works):
```\n# curl working
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>' \
  -d '{"auth_token":"ephemeral"}'
# => 200 { "session_id": "s_abc" }
```

alex: Node SDK (fails):
```\nconst r = await client.createSession({ token: 'ephemeral' })
// => throws 401 Unauthorized
```

chandra: I ran into something similar yesterday. Looks like param name mapping got swapped in the Node SDK: SDK sends `Authorization` header but uses `token` -> `api_key` in payload, while REST route expects `auth_token`.

chandra: Quick sniff from the SDK request (from our dev laptop):
```\nPOST /v1/sessions
Headers: Authorization: Bearer ephemeral
Body: { api_key: 'ephemeral' }
```

chandra: The server now validates `auth_token` field and ignores `api_key` for this endpoint -> 401.

alex: Ah, that explains it. I thought it was an HSM handshake issue.

devex-bot: Deployed patch from #sdk-regen at 1748005000 (version: sdk-node@2.4.7) — rolling back to previous tag for customers experiencing 401s. :gear:

taylor: Workaround: call REST directly from sample app or pass the header explicitly via `client._opts.headers['x-override-auth'] = 'ephemeral'` until SDK fix lands. Not ideal but buys time.

priya: I'll open an integration test that verifies payload field names for `POST /v1/sessions` and `POST /v1/tokens`. We should fail CI if mappings diverge.

priya: Repro steps I'm adding to the issue:
1) Create ephemeral token via console UI
2) Call `client.createSession({ token })` in node sample app
3) Observe 401; compare with `curl` to the same endpoint

taylor: @priya please also add a unit test that inspects the serialized request body (so we don't rely only on e2e).

chandra: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/issues/872 — titled "session endpoint param mapping mismatch -> 401 on SDK". Added logs and server side trace id.

alex: Thanks — marking this as P1 for onboarding flows. A few customers hit this during pilot.

devex-bot: Linking run: nightly-e2e-1748006000 -> failed (session-parity). CI job id: ci/12456

taylor: I'll cut a patch PR to rename `api_key` -> `auth_token` in the serializer and add a changelog note. Will request review from @chandra and @alex.

priya: FYI, this also affects the Python SDK but the mapping there was correct; adding cross-language test to ensure parity.

alex: Great — can we backport to 2.x branch? Some enterprises are on that line.

chandra: Yep, will prepare backport.

alex: :thumbsup: thanks all. Keep updates here so support can copy to customer thread.

taylor: updating GH PR and pinging support docs to include the REST workaround.

priya: test + CI change in draft, will push in the morning.

alex: closing loop: once patch is live, notify #onboarding so CS can re-run the demo flows.
